newsitem.title: USA: CNB Bancshares declares 5 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: CNB Bancshares declares 5 pct stock dividend.

text.p: CNB Bancshares Inc said Monday its board of directors declared a five percent stock dividend, payable September 18 to shareholders of record August 21.

The board also said it intends to increase the fourth quarter dividend payment to $0.23 a share when it is declared in October. Including the stock dividend, the cash payout would effectively rise 10 percent, the company said.
The previous rate was $0.22 a share.
The cash dividend was last increased October 30, 1996, the company said.
CNB shares were up 1/16 at 42-11/16 Monday.
